exposes_tools.name: market.quote
exposes_tools.description: Current price of one asset, in the currency this plugin determined that price is in. Callers name the asset AND its venue; which source answers a venue, at which URL, is chosen by this plugin. Neither source states a currency, so it is determined from the venue and the code range: CRYPTO in USDT, US in USD, HK in HKD below code 80000, and in CNY the Shanghai 6xxxxx (A shares and STAR) and 5xxxxx (funds) codes and the Shenzhen 00xxxx (main board), 30xxxx (ChiNext) and 15xxxx/16xxxx (fund) codes. Codes outside those ranges — B shares, Hong Kong's renminbi and US-dollar counters, and the mainland bond and index ranges — are refused with the reason rather than priced under a guessed currency. Nothing is converted between currencies.

asset.description: Asset name. Bare (`BTC`) means the crypto venue; a venue-qualified name is `<VENUE>:<SYMBOL>` over CRYPTO, US, HK, SH (Shanghai) and SZ (Shenzhen) — `CRYPTO:BTC`, `US:NVDA`, `HK:1810`, `SH:600519`, `SZ:000001`. A prefix counts only with the colon, so `USNVDA` is a crypto name. `CN:` is accepted only so holdings stored under the retired mainland venue still read back; it is never priced, and has to be re-recorded under the exchange that lists the code — `SH:<code>` for a Shanghai listing, `SZ:<code>` for a Shenzhen one, not whichever is convenient. A Hong Kong code folds to five zero-padded digits, so `HK:1810` and `HK:01810` are one holding.

exposes_tools.name: market.holdings.set
exposes_tools.description: Record how much of an asset this Track holds. Replaces any existing quantity for that asset; 0 removes it. Records only — the price is fetched by the plugin's own refresh, which this call wakes. Each venue is priced in its own currency, and a Track whose priced holdings span two currencies gets per-asset rows but no total and no history points — until it is back in one currency, or until currency conversion lands.

asset.description: Asset name. Bare (`BTC`) means the crypto venue; a venue-qualified name is `<VENUE>:<SYMBOL>` over CRYPTO, US, HK, SH (Shanghai) and SZ (Shenzhen) — `CRYPTO:BTC`, `US:NVDA`, `HK:1810`, `SH:600519`, `SZ:000001`. quantity.description: How much is held. 0 removes the holding.

exposes_tools.name: market.holdings.list
exposes_tools.description: What this Track currently holds, with the venue, latest price, value and currency of each. A total is stated only when the priced holdings are all in one currency.

quote.description: The settlement currency a portfolio's total is meant to be stated in. It is not a pricing input: each market is quoted in its own currency and nothing is converted yet, so this key has no effect on the published numbers until currency conversion lands.

binance_endpoint.description: Base URL of the Binance market-data source. api.binance.com is geo-restricted from some hosts; data-api.binance.vision serves the same /api/v3 paths with no key.

sina_endpoint.description: Base URL of the Sina quote list, the US, HK, SH and SZ source. Its /list= path is asked for one symbol at a time: gb_<symbol>, hk<code padded to 5>, sh<code> or sz<code>.
